messages:
alex: Kicking off tenant backfill for schema v2.3 in the maintenance window 01:00-03:00 UTC. Backfill target ~200k rows, current dry-run suggests ~2.5h at full throughput. Need deploybot schedule + final rate plan. Prefer staggered waves to avoid replica IO spikes.

maya: +1 for waves. Suggest 3 waves: 60/80/60k rows. Start with conservative concurrency 6 and rate cap 800 ops/s, bump if stable.

jordan: agree. Add health probes between waves (10m), and abort-if-error >10% for any wave. Who owns the runbook for rollback?

sam: I can own rollback runbook. Quick checklist: 1) pause backfill, 2) revert schema flag, 3) re-run small revert migration if partially applied. I'll post steps in the runbook channel.

alex: thanks. Deploybot, please schedule job with flags: tenant=all, waves=3, concurrency=6, rate_cap=800, health_wait=600s, abort_threshold=0.10. Also pin migration binary v1.14 during window.

deploybot: Scheduled backfill job #4932 by alex for 2026-04-05 01:00 UTC (window 01:00-03:00).
Details: tenant=all; waves=3 (60k/80k/60k); concurrency=6; rate_cap=800 ops/s; health_wait=600s; abort_threshold=10%; pinned_binary=v1.14. Started: false.

maya: One more: please enable prefix KV caching for these tenants to reduce repeated tokenization overhead. Should shave CPU.

alex: Good call. Added cache=true to job config. Also logging: stream errors to #eng-releases and tag as backfill-4932.

jordan: Will watch metrics. If tail latency > 250ms for 3 consecutive minutes or replica lag > 30s, we throttle to 400 ops/s or pause.

oncall-sre: @jordan i'll be on paged rota tonight, stand by. If paged, I'll coordinate rollback with sam. :+1:

sam: Runbook draft (snippet):
```
- Pause: /deploybot pause 4932
- Snapshot: pg_basebackup --wal-method=stream
- Revert flag: ALTER TABLE ... DROP COLUMN v2_partial
- Validate: run integration smoke on sample tenants
- Resume/Abort: decision required from eng-release lead
```
I'll post full doc link after review.

deploybot: Backfill job #4932 queued. Preflight checks: all tenants reachable, replicas lag OK, migration binary v1.14 available. To start now: `/deploybot start 4932`

alex: We'll start at 01:00 UTC. Final call at 00:45 UTC for any last-minute holds. If anyone sees a red flag before that, raise it here. :eyes:

jordan: noted. Will watch DB metrics and runbook ready.

oncall-sre: thumbs up.

sam: leaving approvals in the runbook, alex pls ack when you want me to escalate.

alex: ack. I'll post a 00:45 go/no-go.

(End of thread)
